senses.sense_definition: A substance or agent that blocks or closes a passage or opening.

examples.text: Petroleum jelly is often used as an <w>occludant</w> to prevent moisture loss from the skin.
The medical device acts as an <w>occludant</w> to seal the blood vessel during the procedure.

senses.sense_definition: A substance that prevents the passage of moisture or air, typically used in dermatology.

examples.text: The cream contains an <w>occludant</w> to lock hydration into the dry skin layers.
Dermatologists often recommend an <w>occludant</w> to protect damaged skin from external irritants.
